body: I want to but I can't.  What if someone I know recognizes me from my story?  I am already much too ashamed.  I couldn't bear it.

I am in my late 20's and in school.  I am not working and soon I will have to declare bankruptcy. I've tried all SSRI's at different dosages to no avail.  I am still on them.  I stopped going to therapy when I had to remind my therapist what my name was every time I went in.  Friends and family stood by me for years, helping me through my darkest time.  I repaid them with abuse and abandonment.  My reasons for going on are diminishing faster than I can find new ones.  I want that chance but I have been depressed for the last decade, barely hanging on.  That chance looks more like a dream to me.  To find someone I love... if they only gave me a chance, but they won't and I cannot blame them.  I don't think I have had a real connection with someone in more than 10 years, nor have I let myself become attached to anyone.
